name: Desktop Mascot
tagline: A customizable animated mascot for your Android screen
blurb: Desktop Mascot brings a small animated character to your Android screen.
description:
Desktop Mascot brings a small animated character to your Android screen.

Features:

- Animated sitting, walking, and resting
- Use your own mascot PNG images
- Multiple animation frames for walking
- Adjustable movement behavior
- Optional breathing animation
- Works locally on your device
